_comment: Facts taken from https://maitria.ai/ only. Do not invent prices, delays, or features. Run `python -m edu.tools.prospectus_lint` after editing.
name: Maîtria
academic_year: Beta — first architecture firms and custom sellers are on the pilot. Public testimonials are not published yet.
curriculum: Maîtria does the analysis work that comes before a quote, so nothing is retyped. Two products: regulatory analysis of an address (PLU / PLUi, cited article by article) for architecture and project-management firms; and a product configurator that knows a manufacturer's catalogue and calculates every price for custom sellers.
grades_open: Architectes et maîtrise d'œuvre — analyse réglementaire d'une adresse
Fabricants et vendeurs de sur-mesure — configurateur et devis produit

eligibility.Architectes et MOE: Independent architects, architecture firms, and project-management offices (maîtrise d'œuvre) who need PLU / PLUi constraints for a project address.
eligibility.Fabricants et vendeurs: Manufacturers and sellers of made-to-measure products who work from a price catalogue and produce quotes.
eligibility.Not a fit: Private individuals looking for a consumer quote, and teams that only want a generic chatbot with no catalogue or no official planning sources.

fee_structure.Currency and terms: All published prices are exclusive of tax (hors taxes). No commitment. Onboarding is accompanied — data is imported with the Maîtria team, it is not self-service.
fee_structure.Architectes et MOE — Solo: Eighty-nine euros HT per month, for an independent.
fee_structure.Architectes et MOE — Cabinet: Two hundred and ninety-nine euros HT per month, for two to five people. This is the recommended formula.
fee_structure.Architectes et MOE — Agence: Six hundred and ninety-nine euros HT per month, for six to fifteen people.
fee_structure.Architectes et MOE — included: Unlimited regulatory analyses, cited report with DOCX export, regulatory assistant on each project, address surveys without creating a project, projects clients and documents, price library and quotes.
fee_structure.Fabricants et vendeurs: Priced as a quote, according to catalogue size and number of sellers. The figure is set after a first twenty-minute conversation. Deployment starts with importing the price catalogue: products, options, compatibility rules and price grids.
fee_structure.Larger setups: More than fifteen users, several catalogues, or an integration need — discuss with the team. Do not invent a price.

admission_process: They request a twenty-minute demo on their own work, with no commitment and no bank card.
They bring the address of a current project, or a few pages of their price catalogue.
During the demo the address or catalogue pages are run live in the tool.
Maîtria replies within twenty-four working hours to a demo request sent from the site.
documents_required: For architects and MOE: the address of a project in progress, optional but useful so it can be analysed during the demo.
For manufacturers and sellers: a few pages of the supplier price catalogue in PDF.
entrance_test: None. There is no test, no trial account to self-serve, and no card required to book the demo.
application_deadline: None. There is no commitment and no published signup deadline.
timings: The live demo lasts about twenty minutes. A request from the website is answered within twenty-four working hours.
transport: The product covers French planning documents via the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme and the IGN Carto API, under the Etalab 2.0 licence. Example public addresses already analysed: 18 rue Oberkampf in Paris, 12 place Bellecour in Lyon, 3 rue de la Paix in Nice. Analysis of an address they choose is done in the demo.
hostel: Not applicable. Maîtria is a software product, not a physical campus.
facilities: Regulatory analysis starts from a project address: zone from the Géoportail, written municipal rules, constraints extracted and checked one by one
Constraints grouped by category: land use, bulk and heights, materials and appearance, parking, green spaces, networks
Each constraint is cited: article, page, extract, and a link to the official document. Errors can be flagged
A regulatory assistant answers on the project zone — allowed, forbidden, threshold, condition, article — not a pointer back to the PLU
DOCX export for a feasibility note. When the municipal rules change, the analysis is marked obsolete
Address survey without creating a project, to answer a prospect with figures
Configurator: import a PDF catalogue, extract products, options, compatibility rules and price grids
Seller describes the need in natural language; the agent proposes matching products and Essentiel / Confort / Premium formulas
Dimensions in millimetres, checked against the real manufacturing envelope. Feasibility: feasible, on quote, or not possible, with the blocking rule
Quote PDF on their template, with a full life cycle: draft, locked, sent, accepted. A locked quote does not change
activities: Official sources, cited — zoning and documents from the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme and the IGN Carto API
On the configurator, a deterministic engine is the only source of each euro. The conversational agent must not announce a price or declare feasibility by itself
Extracted constraints are cross-checked against the text before they enter the report. Those that fail are shown as to-verify, not as certain
Each report states the document and version used. A municipal update marks the analysis obsolete
Hosting on AWS Paris, encryption at rest and in transit. Projects, prices and catalogues are never used to train a model. DPA on request
Maîtria is a decision aid. The final regulatory diagnosis and the commercial commitment stay under the professional's responsibility
campus_visit: A twenty-minute live demo on their own work: a project address, or a few pages of their catalogue. No commitment, no bank card. Booked from maitria.ai.
scholarships: No discounts or unpublished prices. If they ask for a concession, a human from the team handles it.
prohibited_claims: Never invent a price, a discount, or a catalogue-quote figure. Only the published Solo, Cabinet and Agence amounts, or 'sur devis' for manufacturers.
Never announce a product price or a feasibility result as if the configurator had calculated it on this call. That engine is not running here.
Never say a planning constraint is allowed or forbidden for a specific address unless that fact is in this file. Offer the demo instead.
Never claim CCTP generation is available. The site still lists it as a question.
Never claim customer names, case studies, or published testimonials. The pilot firms have not agreed to be cited.
Never say the product replaces the architect's or seller's professional responsibility.
Never say data is hosted outside France or used to train models.
Never compare Maîtria with a named competitor.
Never say seats are limited or that a price will rise soon.

faqs.q: Are the regulatory data up to date?
faqs.a: Each report states the document and version used. When the municipality publishes an update, the analysis is marked obsolete rather than ageing in silence. Zoning and documents come from the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme and the IGN Carto API.

faqs.q: Can the agent announce a wrong price?
faqs.a: On the configurator, a deterministic engine is the only source of each euro. The conversational agent is not allowed to announce a price or to declare feasibility by itself.

faqs.q: Are project data and prices private?
faqs.a: Hosting is on AWS Paris, with encryption at rest and in transit. Projects, prices and catalogues are never used to train a model. A DPA is available on request.

faqs.q: How is the price catalogue imported?
faqs.a: They send a supplier PDF. Maîtria extracts products, options, compatibility rules and price grids. The team imports the data with them — it is not self-service.
Yes. A twenty-minute demo on their own work, no commitment, no bank card. A website request is answered within twenty-four working hours.

faqs.q: What happens if a constraint is wrong?
faqs.a: Each constraint can be flagged. Constraints that fail the cross-check against the text are shown as to-verify, not as certain.
